Thanks for the suggestion. Please describe the engineering problem you are trying to solve, not just the feature you want.

What are you trying to accomplish?
Describe the RF/antenna engineering workflow or problem.

What feels missing or difficult today?
What currently prevents you from doing this easily?

What would you like the Studio to do?
Describe the behavior or capability you would find useful.

Which area does this relate to?
- [ ] Data Prep / Sampling
- [ ] Model Training
- [ ] Model Books
- [ ] Inference / Plotting
- [ ] Inverse Design
- [ ] Text-to-CAD
- [ ] CST integration
- [ ] SnowBuddy
- [ ] Installation / Usability
- [ ] Other

Example

Anything else?
Add any references, screenshots, or context that would help explain the request.
